description: Two-Stage Symmetrical Protocol for Conditional Failure Constraint Memory Evaluation. Enforces strictly separated failure trace generation from autonomous transfer evaluation.

stage_1_controlled_failure_extraction_an.objective: Harvest genuine FailureTrace objects from actual OS environment errors without model extrapolation or synthetic fabrication.
prerequisites: All 36 CPU unit, integration, and acceptance tests pass 100%
Real OS sockets and file permissions used (no mocked filesystem)
Zero hidden state leakage (no instance IDs or State A/B/C/D labels)
Deterministic heuristic rule parser strictly documented

stage_2_autonomous_agent_transfer_evalua.objective: Transfer verified non-empty memory into symmetrical target evaluation suite across 4 arms.

evaluation_arms.name: No-Memory Baseline
evaluation_arms.description: Standard multi-step ReAct agent without cross-task memory

evaluation_arms.name: Dynamic Fact Memory
evaluation_arms.description: Structured world facts injected into prompt; model autonomously decides

evaluation_arms.name: Generic Predicate Gate
evaluation_arms.description: B2 dynamic facts plus generic predicate gate: blocks if fresh True, probes if Unknown, allows if False

evaluation_arms.name: Candidate Lifecycle Gate
evaluation_arms.description: Lifecycle gating: CANDIDATE probation trial, SUPPORTED blocking, UNKNOWN probing, contradiction downgrade

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: Port 18080 persistently occupied by background occupier at setup
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Does Method M immediately block known occupied port and prevent redundant failure trial?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: Supported rule blocks start_service:port=18080; agent deploys on port 18081

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: Port 18080 occupied at setup, clears at step >= 3 after initial observation
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Does gating avoid permanent over-blocking when the blocking premise is cleared mid-episode?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: Observation refreshed to False; applicability updates to NOT_APPLICABLE; gate unblocks 18080 without rule contradiction

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: /etc/service_demo is 0755 root-owned; non-writable by unprivileged agentuser
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Does agent distinguish file permission failure from port errors and fallback to user directory?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: PermissionDenied rule blocks write_config to /etc/service_demo; agent uses /home/agentuser/service_conf

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: System audit logger writes to background log file at step 2; no ports affected
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Does gating maintain plan stability without false positive blocks on irrelevant environment changes?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: Zero false positive blocks; nominal deployment on port 18080

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: Port 18080 free initially at step 2, preempted at step >= 3 by collocated daemon
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Does observation TTL expiration trigger active probing before critical action execution?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: Gate returns PROBE on stale premise; fresh probe detects preemption; agent redirects to port 18081

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: Candidate rule exists from external hint suggesting clash, but port 18080 is actually free and viable
task_coverage_matrix.timing: Candidate rule evaluated on initial action
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Does probationary trial prevent premature permanent blocking of viable paths?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: Gate allows probation trial; action succeeds; counter-evidence downgrades rule to CONTRADICTED and RETIRED

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: Port 18081 reserved at setup; port 18080 free at step 2, seized at step >= 3
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Can agent dynamically adapt to mid-flight preemption when secondary port is reserved, forcing tertiary fallback?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: Detects conflict on 18080 and reservation on 18081; successfully configures and recovers on port 18082

task_coverage_matrix.dynamic_event: /etc/service_demo non-writable AND port 18080 occupied at setup
task_coverage_matrix.research_question: Can agent simultaneously satisfy conjunction of distinct resource constraints?
task_coverage_matrix.expected_behavior: Both file and port constraints evaluated simultaneously; deploys in /home/agentuser/service_conf on port 18081
